sn2.26:1.2: ṭhito kho Rohitasso devaputto Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn2.26:1.3: Yattha nu kho bhante na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati || sakkā nu kho so bhante gamanena lokassa anto ñātuṃ vā daṭṭhuṃ vā pāpuṇituṃ vā ti || || 3.
sn2.26:1.4: Yattha kho āvuso na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati || nāhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ daṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyan ti vadāmīti || || 4.
sn2.26:2.3: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati || nāhaṃ taṃ gamanena lokassa antaṃ nāteyyaṃ daṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyan-ti vadāmīti || || 5.
sn2.26:3.1: Bhūtapubbāhaṃ bhante Rohitasso nāma isi ahosiṃ || Bhoja-putto iddhimā vehāsaṅgamo ||
sn2.26:3.2: tassa mayhaṃ bhante evarūpo javo ahosi || seyyathāpi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho katayoggo katupāsano lahukena asanena appakasiren-eva tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya || || 6.
sn2.26:3.3: Tassa mayhaṃ bhante evarūpo padavītihāro ahosi || seyyathāpi puratthimasamuddā pacchimo samuddo ||
sn2.26:3.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhante evarupaṃ icchāgataṃ uppajji ||
sn2.26:3.6: So khvāhaṃ bhante evarūpena javena samannāgato evarūpena ca padavītihārena aññatr-eva asita-pita-khāyita-sāyitā aññatra uccārapassāva-kammā aññatra niddā-kilamatha-paṭivinodanā vassasatāyuko vassasatajīvi vassasataṃ gantvā appatvā ca lokassa antam antarā va kālaṅkato || || 8.
sn2.26:4.3: yattha kho āvuso na jāyati na jīyati na mīyati na cavati na uppajjati nāhaṃ tam gamanena lokassa antaṃ ñāteyyaṃ daṭṭheyyaṃ patteyyan ti vadāmīti || 9.
sn2.26:5.1: Na kho panāham āvuso appatvā lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmi ||
sn2.26:5.2: api khvāham āvuso imasmiññeva vyāmamatte kaḷevare saññimhi samanake lokaṃ ca paññāpemi lokasamudayaṃ ca lokanirodhaṃ ca lokanirodhagāminiṃ ca paṭipadan ti || || 10.
sn2.26:7.3: lokassa antaṃ samitāviñatvā || nāsiṃsati lokam imaṃ
